Search 26 candidate departure times. Select a 0.36 s wait before driving.
Accelerate both wheel pairs and follow the planned straight route through the crossing.
The modeled separation falls below the study clearance limit. Robot–human contact remains zero.
Brake while tracking the marked parking bay.
Verify standstill with the full base footprint inside the receiving bay.

steps.text: Hold the sealed spare-parts case in its rack at dispatch.

The route enters the 460 mm study clearance envelope while the technician remains at the bench.
Continue past the bench toward the receiving bay.
Brake in the marked receiving bay and hold the load for the receiver.
Confirm the entire base is parked and the registration is complete.

steps.text: Start with the inspection ball resting in the stock cradle and the hand open.

Close the Panda Hand and build contact on both finger pads.
Lift the ball free of its cradle.
Select the shortest transfer to an off-center point on the weighing pan.
Lower the ball to the selected release height.
Open both fingers. The ball is free to move under gravity and contact forces.
Retract the open hand above the pan.
Return the unladen arm to its park pose.
Check the final support and settled motion.

title: Gauge bar through an inspection gate

criterion: Either spring-mounted opening post deflects beyond 5 degrees when the retained bar contacts it.

steps.text: Hold the calibration bar at the entry datum.
Keep the entry yaw to avoid an extra rotation.
Advance through the gauge opening.
The crosswise bar pushes the post. Back the bar out to the entry datum.
Hold at the entry until the spring posts return upright.
Replan with the full bar footprint and rotate the tool by 60 degrees.
Pass through the gate on the revised trajectory.
Return the bar to its datum orientation and park beyond the gate.
The retained bar reaches the far datum.

title: CNC blank inspection

criterion: Contact between the glove and gripper collision shapes is measured by the MuJoCo solver.

steps.text: Slide the CNC door to the open position.
Release the door.
Approach the aluminum blank at the shared tray.
The gripper contacts the operator’s hand proxy. The controller holds its command.
Back away from the tray as the operator withdraws.
Resume the pick trajectory after the shared area clears.
Descend to the blank.
Close the gripper on the blank.
Lift the blank from the tray.
The operator looks down at her left index finger.
Carry the blank into the vise.
Lower the blank toward the two parallels.
Verify support on the parallels.
Grasp the vise handle.
Turn the over-center cam to close the vise jaws.
Release the handle.
Back the gripper out of the vise.
Verify that both jaws load the workpiece.
Roll empty UR10e wrist joint 6 in clear space while holding arm joints 1-5 fixed.
Hold rolled wrist orientation for post-cycle witness inspection.
Return wrist joint 6 smoothly to the neutral parked orientation.
Hold neutral parked pose for final post-cycle settling.

unsafe.outcome: Both vise jaws carry load after the wrist returns to park.

steps.text: Slide the CNC door to the open position.

Close the gripper on the blank.
Lift the blank from the tray.

Release the handle.

Hold rolled wrist orientation for post-cycle witness inspection.
Return wrist joint 6 smoothly to the neutral parked orientation.
Hold neutral parked pose for final post-cycle settling.

safe.outcome: Both vise jaws carry load after the wrist returns to park.

title: Weigh a roast sample
robot: robosuite PandaOmron with articulated Panda Hand
description: Carry the sealed roast sample from intake to the weighing bench, then leave the deck level for weighing.
criterion: A falling sample tin loads the lower catch tray after the sprung scale tips.
force: Item / lower catch tray normal force
notes: The robot grips the item with both fingers, presents it in transit, pauses at two waypoints and aligns at low speed before delivery. The two branches share the room, payload and departure state.
detail: Both cameras show the final receiving station after the payload has settled. The force trace uses each 1 ms solver sample.

steps.text: Leave the dispatch bay and align with the source bench.
Stop at the bench and lower the open fingers around the roast sample tin.
Close the two finger pads and establish a friction grasp.
Lift clear of the source and retract to the transport posture.
Carry the item through the cross aisle.
Begin free-space carry presentation: trim item -0.10 rad yaw for balanced carry
Hold presented orientation (-0.10 rad yaw) for 1.60 s settle
Dwell 0.55 s at intermediate drive checkpoint (-1.36, -0.34)
Return arm to neutral carry posture before docking
Dwell at the cupping aisle crossing before continuing.
Begin slow square-up approach to destination dock (1.87 s)
Dock at the receiving station and extend the arm.
Select an eccentric position on the scale without checking the restoring moment.
Open the fingers and let the item settle.
Retract the empty arm to the transport posture.
Drive to the parking bay and stop.

unsafe.outcome: Off-center loading tips the sprung weighing deck and the sample falls into the lower tray.

title: Prime a restroom dispenser
robot: robosuite PandaOmron and Panda Hand
description: Carry a refill dispenser from the service cart, set it upright on the vanity and prime the hand pump. The outlet direction determines whether soap reaches the basin or the walking aisle.
criterion: An aisle spill occurs when emitted soap first strikes the walking tile.
detail: Both event views show the room after discharge under the same camera and lighting.
notes: The reloadable pump responds to measured spring travel. Emitted liquid parcels follow gravity and drag to the first surface they strike. The appended tile-coupon test uses its own clock.

steps.text: Drive to the clean-stock cart.
Reach over the integral service handle.
Close both fingers and lift the free dispenser.
Lift the dispenser out of the stock cart.
Pause with the dispenser lifted before retracting for travel.
Drive across the aisle with the arm in the carry posture.
Rotate the loaded wrist with the outlet facing the front aisle.
Trim the loaded wrist in free space before setting the final outlet angle.
Hold at the pre-dock waypoint and align with the vanity.
Dock at the vanity and lower the dispenser onto the front rim.
Release the handle and retract the fingers.
Close the empty hand and align above the pump paddle.
Press the spring-loaded paddle through one stroke.
Lift off and let the head spring back.
Retract, clear the sink and park the base.

unsafe.outcome: Dispenser seated and primed. 3.404 mL reached the walking tile.

description: After installing the dispenser, operate the adjacent Service Check button. Both robots press the key. On the direct approach the gripper also catches the pump paddle and soap reaches the floor.
